headline: 2014 executive order freezes US-held property of certain people found to be contributing to the situation in Ukraine.
what_it_does: This order lets the US government block, or freeze, property and assets of certain people it finds are contributing to the situation in Ukraine. Blocked property generally cannot be moved, sold, or used while it is under US control. The title does not say which people are targeted or how they are chosen, so the details are limited here.

who_it_affects.group: People and groups the US government finds are contributing to the situation in Ukraine
who_it_affects.how: Their property and assets under US control can be frozen.
They may have to freeze assets they hold for targeted people and stop dealing with that property.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 6, 2014; executive orders like this usually take effect when signed.
